title: Signed envelope base
description: Fields every wire object carries (plan: 'Wire contracts'). subject_digest = sha256 of the RFC 8785 canonical bytes of the object with signature/subject_digest removed. signature (E1) is a base64 Ed25519 signature over the DSSE Pre-Authentication Encoding of that same canonical subject (see wire/signing.py); E0 treated it as opaque. prev_digest (E1, OPTIONAL) is receipt-chain linkage: the subject_digest of the immediately prior object in a chain (see wire/chain.py:verify_chain); absent on a chain's first (genesis) object and on any object that is not part of a chain, so E0 objects validate unchanged.

type.description: wire object type name, e.g. StageReceipt

issuer.description: the identity that issued this object; a principal, never a platform name

nonce.description: single-use per (run_id, nonce); consumed atomically by the host before dispatch (E3)

key_id.description: identifies the signing key; resolved to a trust root by an injected TrustStore (E1), never from this payload

signature.description: base64 Ed25519 signature over the DSSE PAE of the canonical subject (E1); verified only when a TrustStore is supplied to wire.verify.verify

prev_digest.description: OPTIONAL (E1): subject_digest of the immediately prior object in this receipt chain; see wire/chain.py:verify_chain
